subject: Thank you for covering the walkthrough
text:
Thanks so much for stepping in when I had to move the dentist appointment for my child. I felt awful about asking you to cover the client walkthrough, especially since your own deadline was already pushing late that afternoon. I know you had to reshuffle calls, push your design review, and still make sure the prototype was ready for feedback. That was a lot, and I did not fully appreciate it until the project notes came back with your clean edits.

The client actually mentioned the revised timeline, and they said the demo ran smoother than expected. I cannot claim all the credit. You kept things calm while I was away, and your notes saved us from repeating the same questions. I owe you a proper meal, not just a quick thank you note.

I also appreciate that you did not make me feel like a burden. It would have been easy to act annoyed, but you simply asked what needed my eyes and then sent me a list. That helped me breathe between appointments. I know freelancing comes with enough pressure, and you added mine without complaint. I can help next time.

Please let me know a good evening next week. I would like to bring dessert and hear how you managed to juggle everything without making it obvious. I hope your own schedule settles down soon. If I can be the one to cover for you later, just say the word and I will make it work. Take care.
